objective: Make the split-host remote read model apply the same semantic event-stream validation as local logs, and validate remote run summaries before they are projected.
acceptance: local logs and remote payloads are validated by one shared semantic event-stream function

unknown event types, unknown verification status, non-object payloads, blank occurred_at, non-string or unbounded evidence refs, duplicate event IDs and inconsistent run_id all fail closed for remote events
remote payload failures stay inside the existing ReadModelError boundary and never echo the response body
remote run summaries are validated for object type, non-empty unique run_id and integer event_count before display
a canonical remote stream and summary still project unchanged
the pre-existing 413 response-size contract is not duplicated or weakened
evidence: focused remote semantic-parity and run-summary test output
full repository test output and Task Packet gate output
stop_conditions: an interfaces schema, Pydantic contract or server route change is required
a remote authentication or TLS scheme is required
a new dependency outside the standard library is required
a modification outside allowed_paths is required
